reasoning_content:
Build succeeded. Now let's run the app `dotnet run -- server`. The guide says `dotnet run -- server`. Let's try. It starts a web server on port 18080. Let's run in background and check.

But note local.json with sqlite config. Let's run.

action.command:
cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web && export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 && nohup dotnet run --no-build -- server > /tmp/bovis_run.log 2>&1 &
echo "started pid $!"; sleep 30; echo "=== log ==="; cat /tmp/bovis_run.log; echo "=== port ==="; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 18080 || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 18080

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web && export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 && nohup dotnet run --no-build -- server > /tmp/bovis_run.log 2>&1 &\necho \"started pid $!\"; sleep 30; echo \"=== log ===\"; cat /tmp/bovis_run.log; echo \"=== port ===\"; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 18080 || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 18080", "summary": "Run Bovis server and check port"}
